target.title: feat(tencent): add Tencent Hy3 provider (TokenHub and TokenPlan)
target.body:
Closes #99069

## What Problem This Solves

Users on the `tencent` plugin could not reach the current-generation Hunyuan `hy3` model or the TokenPlan endpoint. The plugin only exposed `hy3-preview` on TokenHub, so onboarding (`openclaw onboard --auth-choice ...`), the provider catalog, config resolution, and docs had no supported path to `hy3` on either Tencent endpoint.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds Tencent Hy3 support for both official Tencent endpoints and keeps the provider ids explicit:

- Provider ids: `tencent-tokenhub`, `tencent-tokenplan`
- Model catalog:
  - `tencent-tokenhub`: `hy3-preview`, `hy3`
  - `tencent-tokenplan`: `hy3`
- Auth env vars: `TOKENHUB_API_KEY`, `TOKENPLAN_API_KEY`
- Onboarding choices: `tokenhub-api-key`, `tokenplan-api-key`
- Direct onboarding flags: `--tokenhub-api-key`, `--tokenplan-api-key`

The TokenPlan auth surface intentionally uses the same short-name convention as TokenHub (`TOKENPLAN_API_KEY`, not `TENCENT_TOKENPLAN_API_KEY`).

## User Impact

- Users can now select `hy3` on TokenHub or TokenPlan via `openclaw onboard` and model config.
- TokenPlan works through `TOKENPLAN_API_KEY` without manual config edits.
- `hy3` reasoning support is advertised with the supported `none` / `high` range.
- `hy3-preview` keeps its TokenHub route and its documented reasoning range.

## Evidence

Maintainer validation on PR head `08ccb71cad3f8f05e4a131771ed53c68112773ae`:

- `rg -n "TENCENT_TOKENPLAN_API_KEY" .` — no matches; TokenPlan now uses `TOKENPLAN_API_KEY` only.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/tencent/index.test.ts src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog.test.ts src/infra/dotenv.test.ts` — passed 3 Vitest shards, 94 tests.
- Exact-ref openclaw2 package/deploy: `REPO_DIR=/data/code/openclaw/openclaw/.worktrees/pr-99076 SOURCE_REF=HEAD EXPECTED_HEAD=08ccb71cad3f8f05e4a131771ed53c68112773ae /data/code/myclawworkspace/.agents/skills/openclaw2-ops/pack-deploy-openclaw2.sh` — deployed `OpenClaw 2026.7.4 (08ccb71)`; gateway status healthy.
- Packaged and installed latest Tencent plugin tarball on openclaw2: plugin `tencent` loaded from `~/.openclaw/extensions/tencent/dist/index.js`, provider ids `tencent-tokenhub` and `tencent-tokenplan`.
- openclaw2 runtime dotenv proof: only `TOKENHUB_API_KEY` and `TOKENPLAN_API_KEY` are present for Tencent; `models status` reports TokenHub auth from `env: TOKENHUB_API_KEY` and TokenPlan auth from `env: TOKENPLAN_API_KEY`.
- Live TokenPlan proof on openclaw2: `openclaw agent --model tencent-tokenplan/hy3 --message 'Reply with exactly: OK-TOKENPLAN-LATEST' --timeout 240 --json` returned `OK-TOKENPLAN-LATEST`; logs show `provider=tencent-tokenplan`, `model=hy3`, HTTP `status=200`, and usage tokens.

Docs updated in the same PR:

- `docs/providers/tencent.md` — provider table, auth env vars, onboarding flags, model matrix
- `docs/plugins/reference/tencent.md` — models / auth reference
- `docs/providers/index.md`, `docs/plugins/plugin-inventory.md` — index entries
